name: what-if scenario charts on a dark card
looks: On a near-black card, two splines (the viewer's line and a benchmark line) draw across together while small stat pills pop in beside them. A new headline asks a what-if question and the same two lines replay through a dip, with a shaded loss area and two result percentages landing at the end. It cuts again to a bundle of thin simulated paths fanning out from today's value toward a spread of possible futures, with percentile labels at the top, middle and bottom.
build: Each beat reuses the spline-plus-pill build: two strokeDashoffset lines draw in parallel with a short lag between them, a shaded area fills between them on the what-if beat, and stat pills spring up (response ~0.36-0.42) as each line finishes. The fan chart is 20-40 faint paths sharing a start point, each eased to a different end offset with per-path easing jitter so they settle unevenly, with three labelled callouts.
sound: A rising tone under each pair of lines drawing, a dip in pitch on the what-if crash, blips as each percentile label lands.
prompt: On a dark card, draw two comparison lines together with stat pills popping up beside them, then put the same comparison through a stress scenario with a shaded loss area and two result numbers. Follow it with a bundle of faint simulated paths fanning out from today's value toward a spread of futures, labelled at a few percentile points. Use this as the film's proof-under-pressure beat.
